artifact.name: Never commit credentials
artifact.rule: Never write an API key, token or password into a tracked file.
artifact.rationale: A committed secret is public the moment the repository is, and rotating it is the only remedy.
artifact.violationBehavior: Stop, remove the value, and tell the user which credential needs rotating.
artifact.body: Use environment variables or the platform's secret store.
